# Data validation {#sec-valid}

:::{.aside}

Our setup for this R session is: 
```{r}
#| warnings: false
#| message: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ecoSynthesis)
library(ggplot2)
here::i_am("preparation/validation.qmd")
output_dir <- here::here("outputs/XREFs")
source(here::here("inc/setup.R"))
source(here::here("inc/functions.R"))
load(here::here(output_dir, "lookup-tables.rda"))
load(here::here(output_dir, "memb-tables.rda"))
```

:::

## Read membership table
Read data directly from the data frame and coerce it to a `membership_tbl` object:

```{r}
TASVEG_memb <- read_membership_tbl(
  TASVEG_xref,
  source_id = "VEGCODE",
  target_id = "EFG",
  membership = "memb",
  interpreter = "expert",
  round = "round"
)

TASVEG_memb
```

### Check membership table

Let's check this file for errors:

```{r}
check_membership(TASVEG_memb, source = TASVEG, target = IUCN_GET)
```

### Clean membership table

We can clean these errors with this function:

```{r}
TASVEG_clean <- clean_membership(TASVEG_memb, TASVEG, IUCN_GET)
TASVEG_clean
```

Now we should have a valid dataset!

```{r}
check_membership(TASVEG_clean, TASVEG, IUCN_GET)
```


:::{.aside}

We save both the raw and the cleaned membership tables in a file that we can load in later steps of the workflow:

```{r}
save(
  TASVEG_xref,
  TASVEG_clean,
  file = here::here(output_dir, "memb-tables.rda")
)
```

:::
